'''Basaquer''' ('''バーサーカー'''; ''Bāsākā'' or Berserker) is the third member of [[Jaquio]]'s Malice Four. Trained since birth in all forms of lethal combat, he was once a member of a killer-led organization in China, known as the ''Five Rangers of Doom''. After becoming expelled for utilizing sadistically cruel methods that were too much even for the organization, he was discovered by Jaquio, and made a member of the Malice Four.

When introduced, Basaquer is actually disguised as a regular green ninja at first. He breaks into [[Walter Smith]]'s house and  steals the [[Demon Statue|Shadow Statue]] from them. It's only when he gets cornered in [[Yomi's Cave]] does he reveal his true appearance.

==''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]''==
Basaquer is the boss of Act 3, and [[Ryu Hayabusa|Ryu]] encounters him in [[Yomi's Cave]]. His only movement is restricted to jumping back and forth along the far corners of the room. His main gimmick is with every 1-3 jumps, he will release three knifes in a column to sail forward at Ryu. The top knife actually flies forward first, followed by the others, creating a diagonal slant of knives. Ryu can slash through the bottom two knifes just from a standing stance, but if he only manages to hit the middle one, he can jump in-between the knives. Destroying all the knives is not a good idea, because that will allow Basaquer to attack immediately afterwards.

All of Basaquer's attacks do 2 damage. His biggest weakness is the [[Art of Flying Firewheel]]. If Ryu times it correctly so all 3 fires hit Basaquer as he's coming down (best done by standing in the center of the room), it can rack up 3 damage with each attack.

==Trivia==
* Basaquer is the only boss in the game who cannot be killed with the [[Jump & Slash Technique]]. This is because Act 3 does not provide this sub-weapon in any capacity.
** In the final boss gauntlet, beating one boss like the [[Masked Devil]] will automatically remove Ryu's current sub-weapon before moving onto the next bosses. However, if the player dies on the next boss, they can come back to that boss with a sub-weapon in tow, thus [[Jaquio]] and [[The Demon|Jashin]] can still be killed instantly with the [[Jump & Slash Technique]].
